construction: Normalized rFFT F=fft(raw)/HW; d=F[0,0].real per RGB; G=F/d. Current DC restored after selecting normalized current or aligned inclusive mean. Shared support, current DC, no clipping.
normalized_noise_model: For non-DC, q_G=q_raw/d^2*(1+abs(G)^2), delta-method numerator/denominator independence. G_DC exactly1 with q_G_DC0. Proper circular approximation for ratio noise is nominal only; exact ratio noise is neither Gaussian nor independent across coefficients.
phase_model: Past-only C=sum adjacent,sum RGB G_j*conj(G_j-1). A/B per-RGB adjacent mean energy; normalized q may differ by RGB/frequency/frame. Debiased E_r=max((A_r+B_r-mean(q_a,r)-mean(q_b,r))/2,0). V=sumRGB E_r*(q_first,r+q_last,r)/2 +sumAdjacentRGB q_j,r*q_j-1,r/2. SE=sqrt(V)/abs(C). Use angle only if power>16, coherence>=.8, abs(angle)>3SE. Self-conjugate phase0 and boundary conjugacy enforced.
innovation: Normalized current versus phase-aligned past-only mean, any RGB abs difference>3sqrt(q_G_current+v_G_prior). Same rule/equality boundaries as old significant pilot; amplitude normalization alone changes the observable comparison.
uncertainty: Aligned G mean/prior noise=sumq/m^2; plug-in phase term uses actual i sum(age*alignedG)/m derivative and first-order Cauchy RMS. Restored selected-mean radiance variance records (d_current*sqrt(v_G_mean)+abs(G_mean)*sqrt(q_raw_current))^2; current-selected radiance is exactly current F with q_raw_current. Restoration variance is diagnostic, not a second support threshold.
fallback: Shape errors raise. Any frame invalid radiance/signed/>65504, invalid metadata, d<=1e-4, or invalid signed prediction returns exact raw inactive, cuts history, and is not appended. Reset or any jitter change cuts history. Valid next frame begins fresh epoch.
comparisons: frozen significant phase history64 source pilot
fixtures: 13 exact regenerated old-alpha128x80x64 source families; only fixture generator/scorer sees cleantruth, not estimator. Compare no native T(P).
metrics: Existing frozen score full/mature/startup, absolute every-frame gain[.95,1.05] and phase<=.05, raw invalid fraction, activity, actual residual temporal STD, source-only relative/effective gates versus each control with null0. FP16 roundtrip for all scored outputs.
limitations: Posthoc known source fixtures, not independent validation
No actual source covariance or effectiveN established
Nominal phase formula assumes constant normalized amplitude and IID proper-complex noise
Global denominator noise couples all spatial coefficients
Hard support churn, slow phase nonsignificance and acceleration remain
Restoration variance is first-order nominal RMS accounting, not unconditional confidence
No threshold sweeps or score-based tuning
